quote.text: È cosa di uomo grande e al di sopra degli errori umani non farsi sottrarre nulla del proprio tempo, e la sua vita è lunghissima proprio perché, qualunque fu la sua durata, è stata tutta per lui. Nessun istante ne restò inutilizzato e inattivo, nessuno alla mercé di altri: perché non trovò nulla che meritasse di essere scambiato col suo tempo.
quote.author: Seneca Lucius Annaeus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Treat each moment with your children as precious, ensuring that every interaction is filled with genuine care and mindful presence, for no minute should be wasted on trivialities.
    • Recognize that investing your time in nurturing and teaching them forms a legacy of wisdom and resilience—their future becomes secure when every instant contributes meaningfully to their growth.
  • Leadership
    • Let your leadership be defined by the conscious choice to use every moment effectively, setting an example by avoiding distractions and seizing even the smallest opportunities for guidance and improvement.
    • Empower your team by fostering a culture of accountability and value, where time is revered as the most crucial asset, leading to a more resilient and inspired organization.
  • Product Management
    • Embrace each stage of development with deliberate intention, ensuring that every decision and iteration fully contributes to the product's potential to create real value.
    • Adopt a mindset where no feature or task is treated lightly, understanding that time invested wisely multiplies the product’s success and can transform challenges into golden opportunities.
